title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 283 (Previous Balance Option & Fast Billing Reset)
highlights: Customer Previous Balance on Invoices & Quotations: Optional toggle in Invoice Settings (முந்தைய பாக்கி, default OFF) to display customer previous outstanding balance and total net due across A4, A5, and Thermal prints.
1-Tap Return to Fresh Invoice: After previewing and saving an invoice, the screen automatically clears and prepares a fresh bill with the next invoice number and barcode search focus.
Smart Seal & Signature Photo-to-PNG Studio: Convert photos or scans of rubber stamps and handwritten signatures into clean transparent PNGs.
fixes: Added showPreviousBalance configuration in invoice print preferences and SQLite database.
Integrated CustomerCreditRepository previous balance calculation in InvoicePrintService and CompactInvoicePrintService.
Clean invoice form reset and auto-focus after Preview & Save.
